Leadership is real but fragile—Memory/HBM holds the top by a wide margin yet shows zero breadth, and the macro backdrop is dominated by geopolitics with an unscheduled-surprise share of 100%, so I default to low convição on everything.
emerging_watch: Watching whether Memory/HBM's zero-breadth lead (durability_bar 0.49, breadth 0.0) hands off to Non-AI Software (score 1.282, breadth 0.857). The watch retires if Non-AI Software's score converges to within 0.4 of Memory/HBM while Memory's breadth stays 0.0.

theses.subject: Memory, HBM & Storage
theses.thesis: This is the only theme with a genuinely extended score gap over the field (2.363 vs 1.282 challenger) and it is trend-tagged, non-crowded, and trend-gate eligible. That combination makes it the cleanest absolute-trend survivor on the tape—a focus/attention lens, not a return forecast. The low durability_bar and zero breadth caution me against strength of conviction.
evidence: rank 1 with score 2.363 and margin 1.081 over challenger
gate_helps=true so trend discipline is the validated leg
theses.dissent: Breadth is 0.0 and durability_bar is only 0.49—leadership is a single-name concentration with no cohesive follow-through, so the apparent lead could unwind instantly on any memory/HBM-specific supply news.

falsifier.text: SMH lags XLE by 5% on a 5–10 day lookback before the check-by date

theses.subject: Non-AI Software
theses.thesis: Rank 2 with strong breadth (0.857) and trend tag, but it is flagged crowded (crowding_z 1.39), which per guardrails is a size-down caution only—not a fade. Against the absolute-trend lens it remains eligible, so I lean away rather than short. This expresses my judgement that crowding caps upside relative to the trend gate's drawdown control.
theses.dissent: Broad, cohesive breadth persists while the theme is still trend-tagged—crowding hasn't yet broken the uptrend, and reflexivity says the leader can keep running despite valuation.

falsifier.text: IGV makes a new 20-day high while remaining above its 50-day mean

theses.subject: AI Semiconductors
theses.thesis: Rank 40 with a deeply negative score (-0.492) yet eligible=true and trend-tagged. Given gate_helps=true, this is the textbook case where the gate exists to keep you out of a lagging theme whose trend is poor—breadth is only 0.083, indicating narrow, fragile participation. Avoid rather than underweight because the downside asymmetry is already being expressed in the ranks.
evidence: hurst_tag=trend but eligible=true despite weak score
theses.dissent: A single AI supply-chain catalyst could reignite the whole semis complex and pull even the laggards up violently—avoiding a theme this high-beta carries opportunity cost in a risk-on tape.

falsifier.text: SMH outperforms IGV by 5% over any rolling 15-day window before the check-by date

macro_narrative.note: market-level macro/policy/geo narrative flow; coincident, not per-theme, never a trigger
